_meta.about: The gifts a gate boss leaves when it dies. The player takes exactly one of the three; the choice is permanent. `amount` is added to `stat`; `quest_bonus` more if the player solved that boss's quest (src/boons.py decides how that is recognised).
_meta.design: REBALANCE_MASTER_PLAN.md decision D1. Each stat is offered at exactly two gates. Wisdom gifts are smaller: depth already supplies the clock.

asterion_minotaur.title: Three Things Lie Where The Bull-Man Fell
asterion_minotaur.quest_line: The Thread is still warm in your pack. Whatever you take, you take a little more of it.

gifts.name: The Bull's Horn
gifts.text: You break the horn from his head. It is heavier than a sword.

gifts.name: Daedalus's Design
gifts.text: A wax tablet cut with the plan of the maze, in the builder's own hand.

medusa_gorgon.title: Three Gifts Wait In The Quiet Temple
medusa_gorgon.quest_line: The Aegis hums on your arm. The gift you choose comes with a little more.

gifts.name: Athena's Counsel
gifts.text: The grey-eyed goddess does not thank you. She advises you.

gifts.name: Hermes's Sandals
gifts.text: Perseus left them where he stood.

gifts.name: The Healing Vein
gifts.text: Blood from her right side mends what blood from her left would kill.

fafnir_dragon.title: Three Things Remain In The Dragon's Hollow
fafnir_dragon.quest_line: You met him the way Sigurd did, from below. The gift is the greater for it.

gifts.name: Sigurd's Arm
gifts.text: The stroke that opened a dragon stays in the shoulder that made it.

gifts.name: The Dragon's Bath
gifts.text: Where the blood pooled, skin turns to horn.

gifts.name: The Roasted Heart
gifts.text: Burn your thumb on it, as Sigurd did.

fenrir_wolf.title: Three Things The Wolf Leaves Behind
fenrir_wolf.quest_line: The ribbon held. What you take now, you take with interest.

gifts.name: The Dwarves' Cunning
gifts.text: A ribbon held what no chain could.

gifts.name: A Cat's Footfall
gifts.text: The first of the six things that are not.

gifts.name: The Wolf's Nose
gifts.text: You smell the snow three rooms away.
